---
title: "Video demos"
description: >
  Short narrated demos of mirtverse: The point-and-click workbench, the AI
  Hub and the thesis kit, about 90 seconds each with English captions.
---

Each demo runs about 90 seconds and has English captions. Every number on
screen comes from a real run of the package. To watch on YouTube, use the
links under each video.

## Workbench tour

From a data file to a report without writing code: Load the SAT12 example,
explore it, let the workbench compare the Rasch, 2PL and 3PL models, read
the plain-language results, open the Wright map and an item health card, and
download the report and the R script.

## AI Hub

A machine scorer that agrees with human raters overall, and the check that
shows it scores English language learners too low. Then near-duplicate items
and difficulty prediction from item text.
